evidence: PATHS: The brief names /assets/seed_data.json (instruction.md:15), /instructions/hireops_rules.md and /instructions/integration.md (instruction.md:11). All three exist under task/environment/ and environment/Dockerfile:14-16 does 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'; the Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template's. No other /assets or /instructions path is named anywhere (brief, rules doc, integration doc, app_context, prompts, criteria). seed_data.json parses; its generated_note points to /instructions/hireops_rules.md, which exists. CONTENT vs BRIEF/RULES: seed keys stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, users, jobs, applications, messages, notes, reads, matching hireops_rules.md section 9 ('people, three jobs with their cards in order, the messages (one conversation is long), a few internal notes and read markers ... candidate wording and the page size of 30 are in the same file'). 10 users with exactly the emails and roles in instruction.md:19 and app_context.md:10-19; 3 jobs; 16 applications with contiguous 1-based positions per stage; stage order APPLIED..REJECTED matches rules section 3; candidate_status_labels match the rules section 7 table verbatim; thread_page_size=30 matches section 6; APP-301 carries rejected_from SCREEN and a reject_reason as the rejection model needs. All message sender_ids and application_ids resolve; timestamps strictly increasing per conversation so 'counted from its first' is unambiguous; all Interview counts are within interview_limit (PLAT 2/3, DATA 1/2, DSGN 1/3). No injection-like text in free-text fields. CONTENT vs CRITERIA: every seeded fact the judges quote holds in the seed: app_context 'three jobs', 'Noor Haddad's Platform Engineer conversation is long (120 messages)' -> APP-101 has 120; functional prompt Z/judge Z/D seeded Platform order Applied Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi; Screen Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz -> positions 1..3 / 1..2 match; Noor's note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' -> notes[0] on APP-101; Z/U 'Lena Fischer starts with 1 unread' -> APP-301 has 3 messages, Lena read_count 2, message 3 is from USR-REC3 so 1 unread; K Noor Platform Engineer (Infrastructure, Interviewing) = APP-101 INTERVIEW in JOB-PLAT team Infrastructure; Noor Product Designer (Design, Application received) = APP-302 APPLIED; Tomas Data Analyst (Finance Systems, In review) = APP-201 SCREEN; gates and minimal backend checks use 'the seeded Data Analyst job' which exists (JOB-DATA). The paging criterion hro_thread_earlier (functional judge.toml:337) works on 120 > 30 messages. CONTENT vs SOLUTION: solution/app/src/seed_data.json is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (both sha256 a1c65c80...7e83740); db.js:10 loads it relative to __dirname, solve.sh:35 copies solution/app into /app, satisfying the brief's 'Copy what you need into /app'. db.js:61-87 consumes every seed collection, including read_count as 'last read = Nth message', matching the rules' read-marker definition. RUNTIME (scripted golden, not a judge run): raw-evidence-index entries re-hashed and match (workspace.cjs 3182323b..., results/workspace.json ab65e124..., db.js 0367a73b..., solve.sh 1df2ed04...); results report 'seeded card order and internal notes are loaded' passed, Lena's single unread (workspace.cjs:478-483), Mei's APP-201 unread 2 from read_count 1 (workspace.cjs:269), APP-101 paging of #061..#120 (workspace.cjs:413), restart without reseeding passed. LESSONS FILE: patterns bearing on this row are hidden requirements (lesson 1/12) and seed facts graded by criteria; no criterion depends on an undocumented seed property (positions, read markers, labels and page size are all described in hireops_rules.md section 9 and the seed itself) and app_context.md:30-31 tells the judge not to rely on starting counts, so cross-dimension message additions do not break the seeded-fact checks. Adversarial: a broken app that hardcodes seed views cannot pass the restart/independent-context criteria (other rows); a conforming alternative that reads the seed as described (users, positions, read markers) reproduces every quoted seeded fact, and one with no read marker for a person (e.g. Mei on APP-101) treating all others' messages as unread follows the rules' 'last had open' definition; no criterion grades such an unmarked starting count. Minor note, not a defect for this row: instruction.md:17 says '/assets ... are unavailable at runtime' while the template-controlled task.toml artifacts include '/assets' and test.sh:88 chmods /assets, so /assets may in fact exist at grade time; the brief's statement is only conservative advice to copy the seed, which the golden follows, so it cannot cause a conforming app to fail.
